decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer was launched only in 2018 and its market value is still uncertain, while keeping it in a large marking-systems portfolio costs little, so the option should stay open.
The numbering software module extends the existing REA JET software portfolio at near-zero marginal cost and complements the hardware lines, so there is no reason to give up this cheap option.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces addresses a clear industrial coding need, and one year of evidence is too little to justify abandoning it, so management keeps the option alive while uncertainty resolves.
